# Untis+ 5.2.0

A more personal Untis+ with app-wide visual themes and a clearer, safer update experience on Android.

## Highlights
- Choose from Default, Manga, Vivid, Glass, Cyber and Paper in Appearance.
- Enable Blur only for themes that support it; navigation, app bars, dialogs and cards now use the same material treatment.
- Download the matching Android APK from Settings and continue directly to the system installer.

## Improvements
- Scale alternative launcher icons consistently for Android launcher masks and densities.
- Keep theme, blur and appearance preferences when backing up and restoring the app.
- Guide new users through visual themes, direct updates and backups during setup.

## Notes
- The changelog first loads the latest stable GitHub release and remains available offline through this bundled fallback.
- Android updates are only offered when a compatible APK is attached to a release.
